programme.desc: Live. Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments fro.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP14
programme.desc: Live. One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP20

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP5
programme.desc: Live. At just 16 years old, Theo Walcott attracted the attention of Arsene Wenger, who brought the electric youngster to Arsenal. programme.title: PL STORIES - EP24
programme.desc: Live. programme.title: PL STORIES - EP23
programme.desc: Live. Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.

programme.title: PL MOMENTS - EP7
programme.desc: Live. Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments fro.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP14
